CustomLogoDescription: Replaces the logo in the folder sidebar and above the chat list. PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF images up to 10 MB are supported. ExperimentalMacCmdReplyImmediatelyDescri: Reply to the previous or next message right away on Cmd + Up/Down, instead of first moving the text cursor to the start or end of the input field. Hold Shift to move the cursor as before.
ExperimentalHideAiButtonDescription: Hide the AI Tools button in message compose fields.
ExperimentalViewProfileInChatsListContex: Add "View Profile" to context menu in chat list
ExperimentalShowPeerIdBelowAboutDescript: Show peer IDs from API below their Bio / Description. Add contact IDs to exported data.
ExperimentalShowChannelJoinedBelowAbout: Show Channel Joined Date in Profile
ExperimentalShowChannelJoinedBelowAboutD: Show when you join Channel under its Description.
ExperimentalProfileMediaTabs: Show shared media as tabs in the profile.
ExperimentalProfileMediaTabsDescription: Replace the shared media buttons in profiles with a strip of tabs holding the media lists inline. Work in progress.
ExperimentalProfileMediaTabsExpanded: Split profile media tab into photos and videos.
ExperimentalProfileMediaTabsExpandedDesc: Show separate photo and video tabs in profiles instead of a single combined media tab.
ExperimentalTabbedPanelShowOnClickDescri: Show Emoji / Stickers / GIFs panel only after a click.
ExperimentalUnlimitedRecentStickersDescr: Display as much recent stickers as the server provides
ExperimentalDisableAutoplayNext: Disable auto-play of the next track
ExperimentalDisableAutoplayNextDescripti: Disable auto-play of the next Audio file / Voice Message / Video message.
ExperimentalExternalMediaViewerDescripti: Use system media viewer instead of the internal one.
ExperimentalFFmpegMultiThreadDescription: Allow FFmpeg to use a thread pool for decoding, typically a thread per CPU thread.
ExperimentalCustomNotificationDescriptio: Allow to disable native notifications even if custom notifications are broken on this platform
ExperimentalGNotificationDescription: Force enable GLib's GNotification. When disabled, autodetect is used.
ExperimentalMacModernNotificationsDescri: Use UserNotifications framework for native notifications (macOS 10.14+). System asks for notifications permission on first launch.
ExperimentalFractionalScalingEnabledDesc: Follow system interface scale settings exactly.
ExperimentalHighDpiDownscaleDescription: Follow system interface scale settings exactly (another approach, likely better quality).
ExperimentalUseQtRhiDescription: Render the main window on the GPU instead of the CPU.
ExperimentalEnableVulkanRhiDescription: Use Vulkan for GPU rendering instead of OpenGL when it is available.
ExperimentalFreeTypeDescription: Use the font engine from Linux instead of the system one.
ExperimentalNewWindowsSizeAsFirst: Adjust size of new chat windows
ExperimentalNewWindowsSizeAsFirstDescrip: Open new windows with a size of the main window.
ExperimentalPreferIPv6Description: Prefer IPv6 if it is available. Require "Try connecting through IPv6" to be enabled
ExperimentalSkipUrlSchemeRegisterDescrip: Don't re-register tg:// URL scheme on autoupdate.
ExperimentalDeadlockDetectorDescription: Check once every 30 seconds that main thread is still responsive.
ExperimentalWebviewDebugEnabledDescripti: Right click and choose Inspect in the webview windows. (on macOS launch Safari, open from Develop menu)
ExperimentalWebviewLegacyEdgeDescription: Skip modern CoreWebView2 check and force using legacy Edge WebView on Windows.
ExperimentalFastButtonsModeDescription: Trigger inline keyboard buttons by 1-9 keyboard keys.
ExperimentalFolderFavoriteLinkDescriptio: Favorite button at the bottom of the folders strip that opens a tg:// or t.me/ link.

CacheClearAbout: Media can be downloaded again from the cloud. Files saved manually and message archives are kept.
CacheMessagesAbout: Clears the local cache used to open chats quickly. Cloud messages and message archives are kept. Messages are loaded again when you open a chat.
CacheLimitsAbout: The sliders limit media cache and keep at least 100 MB for small files. Message cache is limited separately to 256 MB.
